chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Is it not pleasing to one of you that he rises before dawn, performs the witr prayer, prays the two rak'ahs of Fajr, and it is recorded for him as the prayer of the night.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for performing witr and the two rak'ahs of Fajr before dawn?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the spiritual efficiency of combining the Witr and the two Sunnah rak'ahs of Fajr, equating them to the full reward of the night prayer (Salat al-Layl). This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on the flexibility of voluntary prayers, allowing believers to maintain consistency in night worship even when time is limited, thereby reinforcing the virtue of Tahajjud and the dawn prayers as a means of drawing closer to Allah.
